description: A modern, cylindrical pendant light with a white, open-weave shade. The shade is constructed from numerous thin, vertical rods arranged closely together, creating a textured and airy effect. Inside the shade, a more solid, multi-tiered structure holds the light source, which is not visible in this rendering. The light is suspended from the ceiling by a slender, white cord and a circular white canopy. This fixture would provide diffused, ambient lighting and add a contemporary touch to a space.
